decision: Accept unchanged observations reproduced in two fresh pinned-original processes and the installed v0.26 control, before implementing a skill-intent runtime. Historical investigation labels remain provenance and are superseded by this record.
scope: 29 native query courses (195 transitions), 32 seal rows, 29 temporary-instance/cursor transitions and 20 native request courses (22 transitions). Total: 278 observations.
correctionsBeforeAcceptance: The actual-request helper initially failed TypeScript narrowing after resetting casting. The assertion now reads the post-operation snapshot; no game behavior or observed expected result was changed.
limitations: Explicit seeded state and synthetic combinations establish original rule precedence. No complete delivery, rendered input, allocation/performance or device claim.
Readiness and actual request dispatch deliberately have different precedence. Full useSkill authority remains outside this extraction unit.

The query helper omits only a gatesMet trace nested inside canUse, an internal forwarder already moved in M30. Future internal-forwarding projections require a separately documented decision and tests; state, results and meaningful host effects must remain intact.
This baseline adds no runtime capability, version bump or public-main promotion.
